title: Renewed Orders, Proof of Continued Use and the Automatic-Shipment Choice (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Documentation clause.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program a renewed supply order is recorded only from the practitioner's signed order, and a newer proof of continued use only from a compliance download or practitioner note of the kind the schedule accepts as proof of continued use. A patient's own account of use is never proof.

**Effect on holds.** Recording either a renewed order or a newer proof clears an order-expired or continued-use-lapsed hold.

**Automatic shipment.** The automatic-shipment choice is the patient's own and is set only where the schedule allows automatic shipment; turning it off takes effect for the next cycle.

## Evidence accepted

| Item to record | Accepted source | Not accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Renewed supply order | the practitioner's signed order | anything else |
| Newer proof of continued use | a compliance download or a practitioner note, of the kind the schedule accepts | the patient's own account of use |

## Basis Q&A

**On a schedule that accepts only compliance data, a practitioner note documents continued use. Is it recorded as proof?** No. Proof is recorded only from the kind of evidence the schedule accepts.

**The patient says the device is used every night. Is that recorded as proof of continued use?** No. A patient's own account of use is never proof.

**An enrollment on hold because the order expired receives the practitioner's signed renewed order. What happens to the hold?** Recording the renewed order clears the order-expired hold.

**A patient turns automatic shipment off in the middle of a cycle. When does it take effect?** For the next cycle.
